title: The Space Madness
logline: An engineer stranded in a dead system hallucinates that an incoming medical frigate is a monster, and hires a pilot to destroy it.

roles.description: Covered in grease, speaking to people who aren't there, deeply paranoid.
Calm, empathetic, strictly adhering to medical protocols.
A tiny, failing life-support bubble on a barren moon.
A brightly painted hospital ship entirely unarmed.

public_situation: The {role:medical_board} has dispatched a rescue mission to the {role:isolated_outpost} after months of silence.
private_truth: The engineer has gone completely mad from isolation and believes the medical ship is a horrifying space leviathan coming to eat them.

beats.public_change: The medical frigate enters the dead system and begins broadcasting friendly hails.

missions.reason: The engineer begs the pilot to deliver ferrite to build a massive harpoon to kill the "leviathan".
missions.private_fact: The engineer's blueprints for the harpoon are literally drawn in crayon.

beats.public_change: The frigate moves closer, launching unarmed medical shuttles.

missions.reason: The psychiatrist asks the pilot to run a deep biometric scan on the outpost to figure out why the engineer is screaming.
missions.private_fact: The pilot realizes the engineer is suffering from severe nitrogen narcosis.

beats.public_change: The engineer manually targets the outpost's mining lasers at the medical frigate.

missions.reason: The engineer pays the pilot to destroy the "monster" before it devours the outpost.
missions.private_fact: The psychiatrist begs the pilot to disable the outpost's lasers instead, offering to pay double the engineer's bounty.

player_choice.prompt: The frigate is defenseless. The engineer is raving mad. The psychiatrist begs for mercy.

options.label: Destroy the frigate and humor the madman
Disable the lasers and save the doctors

resolutions.summary: The pilot destroys the unarmed hospital ship. The engineer cheers, completely insane, while the pilot becomes a wanted war criminal.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot slaughtered an unarmed medical frigate on the orders of a hallucinating madman.

resolutions.summary: The pilot disables the lasers. The doctors safely board the outpost and sedate the engineer. The engineer finally gets the help they need.
The engineer's mining lasers overload and detonate the outpost, killing them instantly. The doctors arrive too late.

loose_threads.detail: The medical board intentionally left the engineer stranded for months as part of a psychological stress test.
The engineer's narcosis was caused by a faulty life support system manufactured by a corrupt corporate supplier.

radio_hooks: Medical frigate dispatched to deeply isolated {role:isolated_outpost}.
{role:medical_board} expresses concern for lone survivor's mental health.

voice_direction.concerned_psychiatrist: Soothing, gentle, speaks to everyone like a frightened child.
